hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap hook that implements a custom constant-price curve using beforeSwapReturnsDelta. It intercepts all swaps, converts ETH to phiEth (via deposit) or phiEth to ETH (via withdrawal) at a strict 1:1 rate, bypassing Uniswap concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity addition to the pool is permanently blocked.
